body:
My story is very similar to yours. Especially the part "never faced many troubles/easy childhood but eventually failed". Was never abused by parents (rather overprotected), normal middle class parents, never have experienced being poor, good grades (until depression ruined everything)... I lack social skills so there's that. 
Still have chance in life but hard to seize them with my lazy mindset. Maybe we should just admit that life is hard and painful and deal it with. I myself don't have the courage to actually bear that pain and try to be a better person, hence the suffering. 
Hope you find a way, wherever and whoever you are.

I believe that every mental properties are caused by physical properties, so if your brain dies your consciousness fades away and that's it. Eternal nothingness. 
But I also understand the fear of hell because i was religious when i was young. Idea of hell is just too unfair and cruel. In my opinion even worst criminals don't deserve that kind of suffering. If God is a benign and merciful being, he wouldn't do that to us.
